mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_privacy_access ( actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, client_ip, user_agent, session_id, request_uri, http_method, trace_id, target_entity, target_user_type, target_id, target_count, pii_fields, access_action, access_reason, result, fail_reason, accessed_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserType}, #{actorLoginId}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{sessionId}, #{requestUri}, #{httpMethod}, #{traceId}, #{targetEntity}, #{targetUserType}, #{targetId}, COALESCE(#{targetCount}, 1), #{piiFields}, #{accessAction}, #{accessReason}, COALESCE(#{result}, 'SUCCESS'), #{failReason}, COALESCE(#{accessedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.sql: log_privacy_access_id, actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, client_ip, user_agent, session_id, request_uri, http_method, trace_id, target_entity, target_user_type, target_id, target_count, pii_fields, access_action, access_reason, result, fail_reason, accessed_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at

WHERE accessed_at >= #{search.dateFrom} AND accessed_at < DATE_ADD(#{search.dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ( access_action LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR target_entity LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR target_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR actor_login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR pii_fields LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR access_reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM log_privacy_access
ORDER BY accessed_at DESC LIMIT #{search.pageSize} OFFSET #{search.offset}
SELECT FROM log_privacy_access WHERE log_privacy_access_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM log_privacy_access WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY accessed_at ASC LIMIT 200
